meta.title: AgentBridge — Transport-Agnostic MCP Client Core Architecture
meta.subtitle: Protocol Decoupling, Session Lifecycle, Connector Integration & Security Boundaries
meta.description: Architectural model of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Client Core in AgentBridge. Demonstrates the clean decoupling between the abstract transport layer, session lifecycle manager, high-level client engine, and canonical MCPConnector adapter. Enforces strict secret sanitization, SQLite ActivityStore auditing, and centralized resilience integration.

components.label:
MCPConnector
(sutra/connectors/mcp/connector.py)
components.description: First-class AgentBridge Connector adapter exposing tools, resources, and prompts as canonical connector operations. Coordinates ActivityStore auditing and secret redaction.

components.label:
MCPClient
(sutra/connectors/mcp/client.py)
components.description: High-level domain client providing clean APIs for tools, resources, and prompts with bounded pagination (max_pages/max_items) and structured error mapping.

components.label:
MCPSession
(sutra/connectors/mcp/session.py)
components.description: State machine and protocol coordinator managing lifecycle states, handshake version negotiation (2026-07-28 down to 2024-11-05), and ping diagnostics.

components.label:
MCPTransport Interface
(sutra/connectors/mcp/transport.py)
components.description: Transport-agnostic contract defining open(), close(), is_connected(), send_request(), send_notification(), and ping(). Shields core client from physical I/O.

components.label:
FakeMCPTransport
(sutra/connectors/mcp/testing.py)
components.description: Deterministic in-memory double supporting protocol version simulation, pagination cursors, timeout injection, and connection drop triggers.

components.label:
MCP Protocol Models
(sutra/connectors/mcp/models.py)
components.description: Structured dataclasses for capabilities, tools, resources, prompts, pagination cursors, and capability mapping to ConnectorCapability.

components.label:
ConnectorRegistry
(sutra/connectors/registry.py)
components.description: Central in-process registry cataloging MCPConnector instances and producing ConnectorAnalysisDescriptors.

components.label:
ConnectorAnalyzer
(sutra/connectors/analyzer/pipeline.py)
components.description: Phase 7.4 generic verification engine inspecting MCPConnector health, tools, and transport declarations without vendor-specific logic.

components.label:
ActivityStore
(sutra/activity_store.py)
components.description: SQLite audit store recording correlated tool execution start, finish, duration, and scrubbed arguments/results.

components.label:
PolicyEngine & Permissions
(sutra/permissions)
components.description: Authoritative governance engine evaluating mutating tool executions prior to dispatch.
